description: Use this skill when the user wants to assemble a multi-role engineering team inside a repository to plan and execute a feature or project. Triggers include "init agent team", "agent team", and "agent team status". Assembles five persona-driven roles — PM, Developer, QA, Security, and DevOps — that coordinate through shared memory and a rolling pipeline: PM plans in phases with explicit gate criteria, Dev implements with TDD and self-reviews via the nasa-dod-code-review skill, QA and Security review completed work without blocking Dev's progress, and DevOps produces the final readiness gate.
